samples.summary: New `hasOpenOverlay()` guard is tripped by the sidebar's *invisible* nav tooltips, silently killing Esc/arrow keys in the image viewer
samples.evidence: `hasOpenOverlay()` (packages/frontend/src/app/files/image-viewer.tsx:32-34) matches `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]`. `SidebarMenuButton` wraps every nav item in a Radix `Tooltip` and renders `TooltipContent` with only `hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}` (packages/frontend/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx:534-543); `TooltipContent` is portaled (packages/frontend/src/components/ui/tooltip.tsx:38-51) and `TooltipProvider` uses `delayDuration = 0`. `nav-main.tsx:44` passes `tooltip={item.title}` for Documents / Data Sources / Settings, which `FileShell` mounts for the image layout (file-shell.tsx:110). So merely hovering — or keyboard-focusing, since Radix Tooltip opens on focus and stays open while focused — a sidebar nav item mounts a popper wrapper even when the tooltip is visually `hidden` on an expanded desktop sidebar. From that instant `hasOpenOverlay()` returns true and both Esc (back to the list) and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (prev/next image) do nothing, with no overlay on screen to explain it. The fix belongs on the new code: the guard should scope to genuinely dismissable, visible layers (e.g. require `data-state="open"` on the wrapper's content and exclude `role="tooltip"`/`[hidden]`), not any mounted popper.

samples.summary: The image header's own Share-button tooltip, and popper exit animations, also trip the overlay guard
samples.evidence: `ImageFileLayout` renders `ShareDialog` in the header (packages/frontend/src/app/files/file-detail.tsx:148), whose trigger is wrapped in a Radix `Tooltip` (`packages/frontend/src/components/share-dialog.tsx:156-170`). Hovering or tab-focusing the Share icon mounts `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]`, so `hasOpenOverlay()` (image-viewer.tsx:32) suppresses Esc and prev/next while a tooltip — not a dismissable overlay — is showing. Relatedly, the popper branch of `OPEN_OVERLAY_SELECTOR` does not require `data-state="open"`, and shadcn's dropdown/popover/tooltip content carries `data-[state=closed]:animate-out` classes, so Radix Presence keeps the wrapper mounted for the exit animation after a close — a second keystroke inside that window is also swallowed. Fix belongs on the new selector in image-viewer.tsx.

samples.summary: Switching the viewer's keydown listener to window *capture* means nested handlers can no longer suppress it
samples.evidence: The listener moved from bubble to `window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true)` (image-viewer.tsx:155). Anything mounted inside the viewer's route that handles Escape/arrows and relies on `stopPropagation()` to keep a global handler from also acting can no longer do so — the viewer now runs first. The overlay guard only covers Radix markup with `data-state`; the repo has several hand-rolled overlays with `role="dialog"` and no `data-state` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-view.tsx:618, packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/components/comments/CommentPopover.tsx:83, packages/frontend/src/app/docs/comments/DocsCommentPopover.tsx:80). None coexists with the image layout today, so this is latent rather than currently broken, but any future overlay added to the `/f/:id` image header (or to `SharedBlobLayout`, packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:766) that is not Radix-shaped will be silently bypassed. Confirming would need a component in that subtree that consumes these keys.

verdict.reason: Every element of the finding checks out in the repo. image-viewer.tsx:22-34 matches a bare `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]` with no state/visibility qualifier, and hasOpenOverlay() short-circuits the Esc/Arrow handler at image-viewer.tsx:150. sidebar.tsx:534-543 renders a Radix Tooltip for every SidebarMenuButton with tooltip, hiding it only via the `hidden` attribute (`hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}`), which does not prevent the portal/popper wrapper from mounting (tooltip.tsx:38-51 portals the content; App.tsx:74 supplies delayDuration={0}). nav-main.tsx:42-44 passes tooltip={item.title} for all nav items, app-sidebar.tsx:145 renders NavMain, and file-shell.tsx:108-116 + file-detail.tsx:137-153 co-mount that sidebar with the ImageViewer on the image route. So hovering or keyboard-focusing a nav item on an expanded desktop sidebar mounts an invisible popper wrapper and silently disables Esc/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight in the viewer. No guard elsewhere scopes the selector to visible/dismissable layers; the existing tests (image-viewer.test.tsx:91-107) only cover a Radix Dialog. Real, reachable, and in the blast-radius lane since it is only visible by reading consumers outside the diff.

finding.summary: New window-level Esc handler navigates away when Esc is used to dismiss the ShareDialog on the same page
finding.evidence: `ImageFileLayout` renders `<ShareDialog documentId={documentId} />` (packages/frontend/src/app/files/file-detail.tsx:148) inside the same subtree as `<ImageViewer onClose={close}>`. ShareDialog is a Radix `Dialog` (packages/frontend/src/components/share-dialog.tsx:155-171) with no `onEscapeKeyDown` override and no `stopPropagation`, so an Esc that dismisses the dialog also reaches the new `window` keydown listener in image-viewer.tsx:126. The dialog's focused element is `DialogContent` (a div), so the INPUT/TEXTAREA/contentEditable guard at image-viewer.tsx:116-123 does not suppress it — the user closes the share dialog and is simultaneously navigated out of the viewer to the documents list. Fix belongs on the new handler (ignore Esc when an overlay/dismissable layer is open, or scope the listener to the viewer container).

verdict.reason: The claimed bypass is already guarded in this tree. image-viewer.tsx:22-34 defines OPEN_OVERLAY_SELECTOR/hasOpenOverlay() matching '[role="dialog"][data-state="open"]' (and popper wrappers, alertdialog, menu, listbox), and the keydown handler returns early at image-viewer.tsx:150 before any ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Escape action. The listener is registered in the CAPTURE phase on window (image-viewer.tsx:155), which runs ahead of Radix's document-level dismiss handler, so the dialog is still mounted with data-state="open" when the guard samples the DOM (documented at image-viewer.tsx:135-137). The ShareDialog the finding names does render a Radix DialogPrimitive.Content (components/ui/dialog.tsx:55-68 via share-dialog.tsx:171), i.e. role="dialog" data-state="open", so it is matched by that selector — the guard, not the INPUT/TEXTAREA check, is what suppresses the keystroke. The exact scenario is covered by an existing passing-shape test at app/files/__tests__/image-viewer.test.tsx:91-107, which fires Escape on an open Radix Dialog and asserts onClose is not called, while confirming Esc still navigates when no overlay is mounted. The finding's cited evidence (handler at :126 with only an INPUT/TEXTAREA/contentEditable guard at :116-123) does not match the code present.

verdict.reason: The Esc handler is not as described. `image-viewer.tsx:138-157` guards on inputs AND on `hasOpenOverlay()` (line 150) before handling Escape/arrows; `OPEN_OVERLAY_SELECTOR` (lines 22-30) matches `[role="dialog"][data-state="open"]` and `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]`. The mobile sidebar Sheet is a Radix Dialog (sidebar.tsx:182-204 -> sheet.tsx:2,56-77), which renders role="dialog" data-state="open", and NotificationBell's Popover (notification-bell.tsx:46,62 -> popover.tsx:2,32-43) is portaled inside Radix Popper's `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]` (the repo relies on the same attribute at CommentPopover.tsx:61). The listener is registered window-capture (line 155), which runs ahead of Radix's document-level dismiss handler, so the overlay is still mounted when the check executes (and React batches the state update anyway). The cited evidence line (image-viewer.tsx:126) is the `nextId` computation, not a key handler.
